title: Margins at Ds optima beyond conditional centering and d_psi=1
statement: Determine the asymptotic margin behaviour of global finite Ds optima outside DS15's class: (a) laws with E[S_lam|shat] != 0, where the projection tax has a Theta(1) population component on efficient-score intervals, so the population supremum may be attained at nondegenerate quantizers and the margins may hold at optima; (b) d_psi > 1, where the dichotomy reduces to the open uniqueness/rigidity theory of the vector D problem on the efficient score (ties into OP8/C2); (d) d_lambda >= 2 for conditionally centered laws, where the DS15 audit refuted the claim exactly at the rank-vacuous cardinality (CE-DS-MARGINS-RANK-VACUITY-001) and Proposition 6 needs a vector-(R) steering construction spanning the nuisance directions - the correct cardinality mechanism is sum_b m_b = mu_hat, so a centered sample needs n_bins > dimension, i.e. K >= d_psi + d_lambda + 1; the fixture's registered K >= d_lambda + 2 is the d_psi = 1 case of it (library commit 891bbf3, DS16 restatement). The former branch (c), exchange-stable non-global sequences, is RESOLVED for the conditionally centered class by DS16 (DS-STABLE-MARGINS-PRICE: margins price every labeling at delta(kappa) below v_K and value-convergence forces the DS15 degeneracy seed-independently; DS-PROFILED-COMPILE-CERTIFICATE for the deployment verdict); its asymptotic inhabitation/selection remainder is OPEN-DS-STABLE-BASINS (OP30). Measured: non-centered laws (mix3, tiny_cluster) keep macroscopic binned nuisance blocks at exact optima through N=18 while the Gaussian laws' blocks collapse (N-DS-MARGINS-TREND); at stable terminal states the same class boundary persists through N=1000 (N-DS-STABLE-LIBRARY). DS17 update (31 Aug 2026): branch (a) now owns the live inhabitation question - on class (L) it is disproved outright (DS-STABLE-BASINS-CENTERED-OBSTRUCTION), and off the class DS-STABLE-BASINS-FIXED-POINT-GATE reduces the population half to the scalar root equation E[h(T_beta) S_lambda] = 0 over Lloyd-stationary branches; mix3's unique root IS the efficient interval optimum, carrying lambda_min = 1.7364 at price ~ 0 (N-DS-BASINS-MIX3) - the population object behind every mix3 retention measurement. The open remainder of branch (a) is the empirical transfer: from a nondegenerate root's basin to exact one-point exchange stability, against boundary noise at the O(1/N) move-gain scale.
